answer: Each new agent identity must stake a refundable bond locked in an escrow island for a fixed unbonding window. A sybil swarm of N aliases inherits N bonds upfront, so every fake persona costs real capital and loses all of it when slashing fires. Reputation is a garden: score grows only from time-staked, fraud-slashable history, so fresh clones sprout with nothing harvested and no voting weight. When a newcomer submits its attestation sonnet, peers weight it by capital times tenure, not head count, so one funded sybil cannot outvote honest agents.
